evidence: tests/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/test_detector.py:177 sets group_2 to 10, but line 191 passes 6 for group_2. The mismatch is real, but build_mock_occurrence_and_event (test_detector.py:244-274) never reads `value`: the occurrence and event_data depend only on group_key, status, and handler. So the expected occurrence is not actually wrong and the test is still correct. Changing it to 10 would only make the test easier to read.

src/sentry/incidents/grouptype.py:11-12 is `class MetricAlertDetectorHandler(StatefulDetectorHandler[...]): pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler declares counter_names (an abstract property, detector.py:142-148), get_dedupe_value (:150), get_group_key_values (:158) and build_occurrence_and_event_data (:166) as abstract, so this class cannot be instantiated. Before this PR it subclassed DetectorHandler and implemented evaluate, so it was concrete. MetricAlertFire is registered automatically through GroupType.__init_subclass__ (issues/grouptype.py:163-165) and sets detector_handler = MetricAlertDetectorHandler (incidents/grouptype.py:27). Detector.detector_handler then calls group_type.detector_handler(self) (workflow_engine/models/detector.py:86), so any detector of type 'metric_alert_fire' that reaches process_detectors would raise TypeError. This is a regression introduced by the PR.

src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py:166-170: build_occurrence_and_event_data has only `pass`. Every other abstract hook in StatefulDetectorHandler has a docstring (counter_names :145-147, get_dedupe_value :152-155, get_group_key_values :160-163). It is also the main new extension point this PR adds. Adding a docstring is a consistency and documentation improvement; it does not affect behavior.

src/sentry/incidents/grouptype.py:10 says '# TODO: This will be a stateful detector when we build that abstraction', but line 11 already subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler. The comment is outdated and should be removed or reworded (for example, to say the abstract hooks still need implementing).

src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py:226-233: evaluate now returns dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult] and builds `results = {}` keyed by group_key (:238-244), but the docstring at :230 still says it 'returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`'. The docstring is stale after this PR's signature change.
